text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) came to a close 
with T.M. Opera O's victory. While Meisho 
Doto was happy for her, a faint trace of 
frustration lingered within.

Growth born from striving toward each 
other— Seeing this outcome, T.M. Opera O 
proposes building a boundary-free bond 
with her peers.

From here on, their whole generation would 
push each other to greater heights, 
determined to create an era of excitement 
that wouldn't lose to the legendary 
"Golden Generation"—

To reach the pinnacle, she must first 
reign supreme over her generation— With 
their newfound bond, Narita Top Road 
charges into the Japan Cup against the 
world's best!
